map.可复现算例：体脂率与身体成分: Reproducible example: body fat percentage and body composition
map.Input: 身高 170 cm、体重 65 kg、腰围 80 cm、颈围 38:
Input: height 170 cm, weight 65 kg, waist 80 cm, neck 38 cm, hip 95 cm (female).
Navy method (female): BFP = 163.205 x log10(waist+hip-neck) - 97.684 x (log10 height) - 78.387.
Result: body fat 13.7%, fat mass 8.9 kg, lean body mass (LBM) 56.1 kg, BMI 22.5.
Conclusion: body fat 13.7% is below range (female healthy band 18-28%), suggesting possible measurement error or being underweight; a combined-method assessment is recommended.

map.海军法测体脂准吗？和体脂秤比呢？: Is the Navy method accurate? How does it compare with a body-fat scale?
map.海军法（皮尺测量）误差约 ±3–4%，优于家用生物电阻抗(BIA)体脂秤在脱水/: The Navy method (tape measure) has an error of about ±3-4%, better than the fluctuation of a home bioelectrical impedance (BIA) scale when dehydrated or post-meal, but not as good as the DEXA gold standard. This tool is an estimate; athletes or special body types need correction.
map.为什么瘦体重(LBM)比体重更重要？: Why is lean body mass (LBM) more important than weight?
map.LBM（肌肉+骨骼+器官+水分）是代谢活跃组织，越高基础代谢越高、越易维持体形。: LBM (muscle + bone + organs + water) is metabolically active tissue; the higher it is, the higher the basal metabolic rate and the easier to maintain shape. Fat loss should preserve LBM and reduce fat mass; weight loss alone may shed water or muscle and lower metabolism instead.
